title: Grateful Dead Live at Cal Expo on 1990-06-08
source: 3 Source Matrix by Dusborne Soundboard (shnid:034397) Source:  FOB Matrix SBD > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHN, Audience (shnid:095184) FOB AUD: 2x Sennheiser MD421's plus 1x Nakamichi CM300 with CP1 cardioid capsule blend mic > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XL-IIS 90's with no Dolby. Set up 30 feet from the stage, FOB center. Taped by Alabama Bob and Audience (shnid:111329) Recorded by The Weasel with 2 Neumann KMF4 microphones (up front) > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording captures an effortlessly magical performance with crystal‑clear instrument balance and radiant vocal harmonies.
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about the show’s effortless flow, praising Jerry’s inspired guitar, Brett’s bright keyboards, Bob’s seamless vocals and the dazzling drum work. The matrix source blends audience ambience perfectly, delivering a pristine, immersive listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Single five‑star review highlights an outstanding performance and flawless recording; limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp mix with well‑balanced audience ambience; no reported flaws or dropouts.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth and effortless, with seamless vocal and instrumental hand‑offs throughout the set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Effortless, inspired guitar work and gentle raggedy vocal praised.
band_member_comments.Bob: Unseen control in vocals; seamless vocal hand‑offs highlighted.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brett's keyboards described as clear, strong, and radiant.
band_member_comments.Drums: Amazing drum performance; no disappointment noted.
